The '''Junti Mace''' was a legendary [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that was considered a myth until it was discovered by the explorer known as [[The Planetwalker]]. The mace was later acquired by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Ziven Tissak]].<ref name="SWG:JM" />
